# agent-harness-adk

> A fast, lightweight harness for building production AI agents: agents, sub-agents, skills, prompts, tools, MCP, memory and the runtime rails underneath them.

Installed as `agent-harness-adk`, imported as `agent_harness`. Python 3.10-3.14. Three runtime dependencies (pydantic, httpx, pyyaml), no vendor SDKs: the Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini adapters speak HTTP directly, so all three share one retry, cost-accounting and tracing path.

```python
from agent_harness import Agent, tool

@tool
def order_status(order_id: str) -> str:
    """Look up a customer order.

    Args:
        order_id: the order number.
    """
    return db.lookup(order_id)

agent = Agent("support", "Answer order questions.", tools=[order_status])
print(agent.run_sync("Where is order 4182?").output)
```

What it covers: the agent loop (think, act, observe), sub-agents from a reusable bench or written at run time by a factory, skills with progressive disclosure, versioned prompts, four memory scopes, MCP over stdio and HTTP, and the runtime rails underneath all of it - permissions, budgets, rate limits, hooks, guardrails, tracing, an immutable audit trail, service health, checkpoints, deterministic replay, isolated workspaces and quality evaluation.

## Examples

Every example runs without an API key - they fall back to a scripted `FakeProvider`.

- [01_quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/01_quickstart.py): An agent with one tool — the smallest useful thing.
- [02_subagents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/02_subagents.py): A manager delegating to sub-agents in parallel, with per-sub-agent cost.
- [03_skills_and_memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/03_skills_and_memory.py): Skills loaded from disk, and memory that outlives the session.
- [04_rails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/04_rails.py): Permissions, budget, hooks, guardrails, tracing and the run journal.
- [05_orchestrator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/05_orchestrator.py): The whole pipeline: plan, staff, run in parallel, consolidate, review.
- [06_assurance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/06_assurance.py): Stop control, audit trail, health, replay and quality evaluation.
- [07_governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/07_governance.py): Governance: EU and Saudi customers on one harness — residency, approvals, erasure and the evidence report.
- [08_governance_saudi_government](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/08_governance_saudi_government.py): Governance for a Saudi government service: in-Kingdom residency, four-eyes approvals through the queue, SDAIA breach clock, DPIA draft.
- [09_governance_singapore_fintech](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/09_governance_singapore_fintech.py): Governance under Singapore's agentic framework: monitor then enforce, prompt injection, inherited authority, tool drift.
- [10_modes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/10_modes.py): Modes: a chat that keeps its thread, research with a checked source ledger, and cowork that plans, asks, and hands back files.
- [11_sandboxes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/11_sandboxes.py): Sandboxes: cowork inside a Docker container (or any other sandbox), with the files it wrote handed back.
- [12_sessions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/12_sessions.py): Sessions in a database: owned, listed by user, continued by another process, and two requests on one chat both keeping their turn.
- [13_multimodal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/13_multimodal.py): Attachments: a spreadsheet, an image and a recording handed to an agent, each reaching the model as the model can take it.
- [14_voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/14_voice.py): A voice agent: voice-activity detection, a spoken answer that starts before the model finishes, a tool call, and an interruption.
- [15_handoffs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/15_handoffs.py): Handoffs: a front desk hands the conversation to a specialist, who answers the customer directly, keeps the next turn, and hands back.
- [16_workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/16_workflows.py): A declared workflow in YAML: parallel lookups, a foreach, a branch, and a write-and-review loop, with shared state between the steps.
- [17_a2a](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/17_a2a.py): A2A: an agent served over the agent-to-agent protocol on a real socket, called by a client, streamed, and used as another agent's sub-agent.
- [18_openapi](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/18_openapi.py): OpenAPI → tools: an agent given an API's openapi.json calls its operations, with a key it never sees and an approval before a write.
- [19_mcp_server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/19_mcp_server.py): Agents served as an MCP server, each behind its own API key: what each key opens, what is refused, and an agent using another over MCP.
- [20_web_search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/20_web_search.py): Web search: an engine that fails, a fallback that answers, the domain policy and the cache, and an agent that answers from what it found.
- [21_browser](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuhammadHusnainAli/agent-harness-adk/main/examples/21_browser.py): Browser and computer use: an agent opens pages and fills in a form by the page's numbered elements, then works the same browser by mouse and screenshot.
